Operator:
Good day, and welcome to the AetherCloud Q3 FY2024 Earnings Conference Call. All participants are in listen-only mode. After the presentation, we will conduct a question-and-answer session. If you would like to ask a question at that time, please press star one on your touchtone phone and wait for further instructions. As a reminder, this conference is being recorded.

I would now like to turn the call over to Sarah Johnson, Head of Investor Relations. Please go ahead.

Sarah Johnson:
Good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for joining us. Today, we will be discussing AetherCloud's results for the Q3 FY2024. With me on the call are Alex Rivera, Chief Executive Officer; Jordan Lee, Chief Financial Officer; Taylor Kim, Chief Technology Officer; Morgan Patel, Chief Product Officer; Casey Wong, Chief Marketing Officer; Riley Chen, Chief Sales Officer; Drew Santos, Chief Security Officer; and Jordan Ellis, Chief Innovation Officer.

Before we begin, I would like to remind you that today's call contains forward-looking statements. These statements are subject to risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially. Please refer to our SEC filings for a complete discussion of these risks.

Now, I'll turn the call over to Alex Rivera.

Alex Rivera:
Thank you, Sarah, and good afternoon, everyone. Thank you for joining us today. AetherCloud delivered exceptional results for the Q3 FY2024, demonstrating the strength of our cloud platform and the increasing demand for our AI-driven solutions across diverse industries.

During the quarter, we focused on eight key strategic priorities:
1. Expanding our global reach through strategic partnerships.
2. Driving innovation in edge computing and IoT solutions.
3. Enhancing our commitment to open source technologies.
4. Strengthening our data privacy and compliance programs.
5. Investing in our employees' professional development.
6. Improving our operational efficiency through automation.
7. Fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.
8. Accelerating the adoption of sustainable cloud practices.

These efforts have positioned us at the forefront of the cloud computing landscape, particularly amid surging demand for AI-driven workloads, hybrid multi-cloud architectures, and sovereign data solutions. For the quarter ended September 30, 2024, we delivered record revenue of $32.4 billion, up 27% year-over-year and 8% quarter-over-quarter, surpassing our guidance midpoint and highlighting our leadership. Full-year FY2024 revenue guidance is now raised to $128-130 billion, implying 26-28% growth, powered by our hyperscale platform's scale and innovation.

Our Infrastructure-as-a-Service and Platform-as-a-Service segments, making up 72% of total revenue, grew 35% year-over-year to $23.3 billion, propelled by explosive adoption of our AetherAI Foundry suite, where generative AI and large language model inference workloads surged 52% year-over-year. We've seen strength in high-performance computing for training foundation models, with customers scaling to thousands of NVIDIA H100 GPUs on our platform, backed by 99.999% SLA uptime and seamless Kubernetes orchestration via AetherKube.

Software-as-a-Service and data analytics revenues reached $6.5 billion, up 22% year-over-year, driven by our Aether Data Lakehouse, a managed Apache Iceberg-compatible service gaining share from legacy analytics players. Net revenue retention expanded to 118%, up 200 basis points sequentially, as customers grew footprints by 25% on average. We added 1,200 new enterprise logos, including Fortune 500 firms in fintech and life sciences, pushing total customers past 45,000 with ARR over $145 billion.

Profitability reflects operational leverage: GAAP gross margin hit 78.2%, up 310 basis points year-over-year, thanks to GPU efficiencies and our custom AetherCore AX-2 accelerators in 60% of data centers. Non-GAAP operating margin reached 32.4%, with $10.5 billion in operating income. Free cash flow was $11.2 billion, or 35% of revenue, funding $8.5 billion in repurchases and maintaining $70 billion in cash. Capex at $13 billion, or 40% of revenue, expanded us to 48 regions, including EU sovereign zones for GDPR and APAC edge for 5G.

Regionally, Americas grew 34% to $18.2 billion (56%), led by U.S. public sector under FedRAMP High. EMEA hit 29% growth to $7.8 billion (24%), strong in Germany and France. APAC shone at 42% to $6.4 billion (20%), via Japan and India expansions. Our pillars—AI ubiquity, sustainable scale, ecosystem leadership—shine through: $2.5 billion R&D for AetherQuantum confidential computing, 50% renewable energy with 1.15 PUE, Arm/Qualcomm partnerships, and AetherMarketplace generating $1.5 billion in partner revenue, up 40%.

Now, I'll turn the call over to Jordan Lee to provide a detailed overview of our financial performance.

Jordan Lee:
Thank you, Alex. We are very pleased with our financial results for the Q3 FY2024. Revenue increased by 27% year-over-year to $32.4 billion, exceeding our guidance for the quarter. Our gross margin was 74.2%, driven by our efficient cost management and economies of scale. Our operating margin was 32.4%.

Diving deeper into total revenue, this was a standout quarter driven by accelerating AI and high-performance computing demand across IaaS, PaaS, and AI-native services. We beat our $31.0 to $31.5 billion guidance range—about 3% above midpoint, our 12th straight quarter topping expectations. This came from faster ramps in AI training contracts and elastic compute, adding $400 million beyond models.

Year-over-year, 27% growth from $25.5 billion outpaces the 21% cloud market per IDC, exceeding AWS's 19% and matching Google Cloud's 28-29% in the gen AI surge. AI/ML services, 28% of revenue up 45% year-over-year, contributed 60% of increment via AetherAI Fabric with H100s and AetherTPU v2, signing Fortune 50 LLM deals for $2.1 billion bookings at 92% utilization. Core IaaS grew 24% to $16.9 billion on EBS and networking surges. PaaS/SaaS up 22% to $6.5 billion via serverless and AetherQL migrations.

North America at 65% grew 25% to $21.1 billion on AI hyperscalers. EMEA 18% up 35% to $5.8 billion on sovereign clouds. APAC 12% exploded 42% to $3.9 billion, Japan/India leading. Latin America/other 5% up 28%. Capex $5.2 billion for sustainable centers (50% carbon-free), Aether Hybrid Mesh for multi-cloud. RPO $145 billion up 32%, visibility strong.

Next, I'd like to introduce Taylor Kim, who will provide an update on our technology strategy and roadmap.

Taylor Kim:
Thank you, Jordan. We are committed to leading the way in cloud technology innovation. We are making significant investments in research and development to create cutting-edge solutions for our customers.

Our network performance and reliability metrics continue to underpin this leadership, where milliseconds count for AI inference, autonomous data pipelines, and e-commerce scale. In Q3, we hit 99.999% monthly uptime across 42 AZs, exceeding SLAs—5.3 minutes downtime monthly, 15 basis points better year-over-year. Global end-to-end latency averaged 28 ms intra-region, p99 at 42 ms; inter-region 78 ms, down 22% year-over-year. Peak bandwidth 1.2 Pbps up 18% quarter-over-quarter, packet loss 0.0004%, jitter 1.2 ms down 10%.

North America (52% traffic): 99.9998% uptime, 32 ms p99. EMEA (28%): 99.9995%, 45 ms p99 on 400Gbps DWDM. APAC (20%): 99.9992%, 92 ms p99. $2.4 billion FY24 capex (28% of infra) drives this: AetherFlow 2.0 SDN with eBPF/AI routing cuts outliers 30%; 450 Anycast endpoints slash cold-starts 40%; AetherDirect 2.0 at 150 Tbps; Chaos Mesh drops MTTR to 2.7 minutes, zero P1 outages.

These fuel 28% revenue growth in AI/HPC, churn under 0.2%. FY25: TbE fabric, SpaceX LEO trials, FiberLink acquisition for $250 billion egress market.

Now, I'll pass it over to Morgan Patel to discuss our product roadmap and recent launches.

Morgan Patel:
Thank you, Taylor. We recently launched AetherEdge Zones, a groundbreaking solution designed to revolutionize hybrid multi-cloud deployments.

Focusing on cloud services gross margin, a key profitability metric for our 92% revenue share from IaaS/PaaS/SaaS like AetherCompute and AetherFunctions. Q3 margin expanded to 74.2%, up 210 basis points year-over-year and 80 quarter-over-quarter—11th straight quarter, matching AWS, ahead of Azure. Trailing 12 months: 450 basis points expansion, $2.1 billion extra profit.

Product mix shift: AI/ML 28% of cloud revenue (up from 18%), 82% margins; serverless/containers 15% at 78%; IaaS 22% at 68%—120 basis points gain. AI to 35% by 2025 adds more. Efficiencies: 92% utilization via AetherOptix scheduler, AetherCore ASICs 40% better TOPS/watt; CoR up 22% vs 28% revenue. Power/cooling $4.2 billion offset by renewables at $0.032/kWh, liquid cooling.

Pricing stable, premiums for AI; regions: Americas 76.5%, EMEA 71.8%, APAC 70.2%. Initiatives: Gen-4 ASICs, 100% renewables by 2026, AetherEdge at 85% margins. Q4 guide 74.5-75.5%, FY25 75-77%.

I'll now hand it over to Casey Wong to provide an update on our marketing initiatives and brand strategy.

Casey Wong:
Thank you, Morgan. Our marketing efforts are focused on building brand awareness and driving demand for our innovative solutions.

Geographic diversification captures the $800 billion TAM. Total revenue $32.4 billion, up 31% year-over-year, 8% quarter-over-quarter on AI/ML, gen AI, sovereign clouds. Americas 52% or $16.8 billion, up 35%: US East/West +200 MW, $4.2 billion IaaS, DoD $1.1 billion, LatAm $1.5 billion up 28%. RPO $105 billion up 40%.

EMEA 26% $8.4 billion up 26%, flat sequentially on FX: Germany/Nordics sovereign $2.5 billion, Deutsche Bank-like $900 million ARR, Aramco $750 million, 85% renewables. RPO $48 billion up 33%.

APAC 22% $7.1 billion up 38%, 12% QoQ: Japan/Australia 45%, $1.8 billion AI up 55%, India 52% $1.2 billion, SEA $800 million. RPO $42 billion up 48%. 'Follow the Workload': 15 new AZs FY25, APAC to 25% mix. Q4 30-35% growth, AI 28% revenue.

Next, I'd like to introduce Riley Chen, who will discuss our sales performance and customer acquisition strategies.

Riley Chen:
Thank you, Casey. Our sales team has been instrumental in driving our strong growth in the Q3 FY2024. We are focused on expanding our customer base and strengthening our existing relationships.

Our overall gross margin trends reflect platform efficiency: 71.2% consolidated, up 210 basis points year-over-year, 50 sequentially—11th expansion quarter. Service mix: AI/ML 28% at 82% margins (up from 22%), +120 basis points; IaaS 66%. Infrastructure: 86% utilization, 1.07 PUE, Graviton4 25% better performance, serverless 85%+ margins.

Headwinds: Capex depreciation up 80 basis points to 22.5% on $2.8 billion AI data centers. Regions: Americas 73.4%, EMEA 71.8%, APAC 68.2%. Next-Gen Efficiency: 100% renewables next year (92% now), Blackwell GPUs. FY25 72.5-73%, AI to 35%.

Now, I'll pass it over to Drew Santos to discuss our security initiatives and commitment to data protection.

Drew Santos:
Thank you, Riley. Security is paramount to our mission. We are committed to protecting our customers' data and ensuring the integrity of our cloud platform.

In a multi-tenant world handling petabytes daily, we've invested $1.2 billion in FY24 security, up 28% year-over-year—12% of opex, above 9-10% peer average. Personnel: 3,200 team members up 22%, 650 hires including 120 PhDs, $285k comp, 92% retention. Security Academy trained 2,100 on deepfakes, zero-trust.

Infrastructure: $750 million CapEx, 50,000 HSMs quantum-resistant, 80% confidential compute, $300 million GTIN for 2.5 Tbps DDoS, SIEM MTTD 12 seconds. Blocked 1.2 billion attempts, zero breaches. Initiatives: Zero-Trust Everywhere 95%, Sentinel AI 85% ransomware prediction, IIaaS WORM, Multi-Cloud Guardian.

Regional: EMEA $320 million GDPR homomorphic, APAC $420 million IRAP/APTs, Americas ransomware scrubbing. NPS 78. Churn 1.2%, $2.8 billion security ARR. FY25 $1.6 billion spend for quantum/GenAI. ROI: $4.50 per $1.

Finally, I'd like to introduce Jordan Ellis, who will share insights into our innovation strategy and future growth opportunities.

Jordan Ellis:
Thank you, Drew. We are constantly exploring new technologies and business models to drive innovation and create value for our customers.

Cloud services revenue hit $29.8 billion, cornerstone with 18% quarter-over-quarter growth from $25.3 billion Q2, 31% year-over-year from $22.7 billion Q2 FY23—exceeding guidance, outpacing 25-28% hyperscaler growth. Drivers: AI/ML 145% YoY to 22% revenue, H100/A100 at 85% utilization, $500 million ARR automotive; enterprise 42% top 500, NRR 118%; edge 62% YoY; 15 regions +2.5 million vCPUs, Graviton4 20% savings.

QoQ: AI 22%, compute/storage 17%, databases 19%; margins +250 bps to 72%. YoY regions: Americas 55% 28%, EMEA 25% 38%, APAC 20% 42%. Guide Q4 $30.8-31.2 billion, 17-19% QoQ, 30%+ YoY. GPU mitigants: Aether Fabric 30% lower latency, Quantum Safe.

Back to Alex Rivera.

Alex Rivera:
Thank you, everyone. We are confident in our ability to continue to execute our strategy and deliver long-term sustainable growth.

Operator:
Ladies and gentlemen, our first question comes from Ben Smith with Goldman Sachs. Please go ahead.

Ben Smith:
Thanks, and congrats on the strong quarter. On AI growth, how sustainable is the 145% in cloud services, especially with GPU constraints?

Alex Rivera:
Thanks, Ben. Sustainability is baked in—our forward contracts secure 40% more NVIDIA Hopper, and custom silicon like AetherTPU ramps utilization to 92%. Multi-year RPO weighted to AI gives visibility, and inference shift post-training keeps momentum as we see with peers.

Operator:
Our next question comes from Lisa Chen with Morgan Stanley. Please go ahead.

Lisa Chen:
Great results. Can you expand on gross margin outlook amid capex intensity?

Jordan Lee:
Absolutely, Lisa. FY25 cloud margins to 75-77% with AI mix to 35%, 93% utilization, Gen-4 ASICs cutting CoR 15%. Capex $90-100 billion over two years yields 25%+ ROIC, renewables save $150 million yearly.

Operator:
Our next question comes from Mike Patel with JPMorgan. Please go ahead.

Mike Patel:
On security investments, how do they impact churn and sales cycles?

Jordan Ellis:
Mike, security de-risks migrations—churn at 1.2% vs 4% industry, 22% faster cycles, $2.8 billion ARR from upsells. 95% CISOs prioritize it, fueling share gains.

Operator:
Our next question comes from Emma Rodriguez with Barclays. Please go ahead.

Emma Rodriguez:
Network latency in APAC—any updates on improvements?

Taylor Kim:
Yes, Emma. SEA-ME-WE 6 cables and $500 million investments target sub-50 ms p99 FY25, TbE rollout, LEO trials. Already 92 ms down 22% year-over-year.

Alex Rivera:
Thank you for your thoughtful questions and your continued interest in AetherCloud.

Sarah Johnson:
Thank you for joining us today. This concludes the call.

Operator:
This concludes today's conference call. Thank you for your participation. You may now disconnect.
